title: 8 Pack Multi-Purpose Plastic Funnels with Long Reaching Spout (4.7”) for Water Bottle, Easy and Smooth Content Transfer by ZMYBCPACK
description:
About this item
Package contains: 8 pack plastic funnels with long reaching spout
Material: Made of plastic, translucent, lightweight but durable
Easy to transfer: Features a wide top opening of 4.7” and 0.6” at the bottom of the spout, which making transfer easily and sit stably on bottles or jars
Multipurpose: Great for transferring water, juice, detergent, dry powder gravel and more
Application: Avoid having a messy kitchen counter top or work table by using this funnel. Suitable for home, kitchen, travelling and outdoor activities
reviews_5s: Well, i bought two different sets of funnels and liked this one much more than the other, so i feel slightly qualified and compelled to write a review here. This 8-pack of funnels is a great value for what you get. the funnels are large enough for use around the kitchen/house/yard/auto and the are very sturdy plastic. The other set that i bought were made of a plastic that was not as rigid and i guess a little cheaper feeling. To be honest, they all would've worked just fine, I mean it's a funnel. I just liked the way these ones felt in hand better. Used them with long 1/2" I.D. plastic tubing to make sound tubes/voice pipes, so no liquid involved here, just sound waves.perfect!Perfect for what I neededGood quality at a good price. I’m satisfied with this purchase.They were bigger than I expected, but then I didn’t look up the size 5”. They will work for what I plan on doing. Smaller would have been better I think. But the price was right. 😁Good sized funnels and fairly sturdy. I’m glad they came in an 8 packs because I use funnels for a variety of tasks now I can have designated funnels for each task like painting, adding oils to cars, draining grease from meat, adding fluids to spray bottles, etc. They have not melted from hot grease yet, they are also easy to clean. If using for paint, I recommend washing right away before the paint has time to dryA nice set of sturdy funnels in a useful size for most applications. They are opaque so you can see the liquid being poured through and the bottom opening is a good diameter so liquid doesn’t back-up or gurgle down the tube.These were exactly what i was looking for. They were perfect. I highly recommend them.Bought these cause the tip looked wider than most funnels but stil would fit in watter bottles, its perfect. Its stong plastic, i was able to add tea with herbs and lots of honey with out it clogging up in a tiny funnel tip.A lot bigger than what I thought. They're great, though. I have a lot of water bottles and I can just add my supplements right into them with these.
